points: Adonibezek flees and is caught, and his thumbs and great toes are cut off. He confesses it himself: threescore and ten kings with their thumbs and great toes cut off gathered their meat under his table, and as he had done, so God requited him.

note.label: Judges 1: Judah Goes Up First, but the Inhabitants Are Not Driven Out

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Adoni-bezek
cases.charge: Mutilating seventy kings and feeding them under his table
cases.preview: After the death of Joshua, Judah went up first at the Lord’s word, with Simeon his brother, and slew ten thousand Canaanites and Perizzites in Bezek.
